description: This file defines a Java interface named ContentImageGet, which extends the ImageGet interface and declares methods for retrieving images and image names from content storage, including handling of content types and merchant store codes.

classes.name: ContentImageGet
classes.description: A Java interface for accessing content images, extending ImageGet, with methods for retrieving images and image names based on merchant store code and content type.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Retrieves an image as OutputContentFile based on merchant store code, image name, and content type, may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: getImageNames
methods.description: Retrieves a list of image names for a given merchant store code and content type, may throw ServiceException.
